title: Attitude Profile (Geographic Pointing)
text: 计算最短四元数旋转，输入 10 路、输出 2 路；按 {Celestial target} 指定天体；{Output rotation from current to updated attitude} 输出旋转、{Output attitude} 输出更新后的姿态、{Port coordinate frame} 指定位置、速度和姿态端口的坐标系、{Pointing mode} 指定主矢量对准指向模式 Point、{Allow pointing mode change during run} 允许在运行期间更改指向模式、{Primary alignment (body-frame)} 指定主对准向量、{Secondary alignment (body-frame)} 指定次对准向量、{Constraint coordinate frame, CCF} 指定约束坐标系、{Primary constraint (CCF)} 指定主约束、{Secondary constraint (CCF)} 指定次约束，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 速度状态向量位置 3-element vector

ports.name: q new
ports.summary: 更新后的航天器姿态 4-element vector

params.name: Output rotation from current to updated attitude
Output attitude
params.values: 输出更新后的姿态 off (default) | on

params.name: Port coordinate frame
params.values: 位置、速度和姿态端口的坐标系 ICRF (default) | Fixed-frame

params.name: Pointing mode
params.values: 主矢量对准指向模式 Point at nadir (default) | Point at celestial body | Point at LatLonAlt | Custom

params.name: Allow pointing mode change during run
params.values: 允许在运行期间更改指向模式 off (default) | on

params.name: Celestial target
params.values: 天体 Sun (default) | Mercury | Venus | Moon | Mars | Jupiter | Saturn | Uranus | Neptune | Pluto | Solar system barycenter | Earth-Moon barycenter

params.name: Constraint coordinate frame, CCF
params.values: 约束坐标系 ICRF (default) | Fixed-frame | LVLH | NED | Body-fixed
